name: Rifat Shahriyar
bio: Rifat Shahriyar is a professor in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at BUET and works on memory management, programming languages, software engineering and natural language processing. They are a co-author of BanglaBERT and the XL-Sum multilingual summarization dataset from BUET's NLP group.
known_for: BanglaBERT and BanglaT5 Bangla language models
